events.excerpt: Overview ======== The 1.2.3 node release is an important upgrade from version 1.2.2 that contains a number of performance improvements, most notably to initial block download (IBD) and block validation, together with new features and bug fixes. Important fixes and improvements in 1.2.3 ----------------------------------------- * Improved initial block download (IBD) and block validation performance. The CoinsDB (UTXO) database configuration has been simplified and re-tuned: a larger default file size, a dynamically calculated limit on open files, and a dedicated cache setting. See the configuration section below and the file [ibd-performance.md](ibd-performance.md) for more details. * TCP socket improvements: - The P2P socket loop now waits with poll() instead of select() on Linux and BSD. Release Date: November 6, 2026

## **Overview** This release fixes a remote node crash in the debug tracing API, updates third-party libraries that had published vulnerabilities, moves builds and CI to Go 1.27 and fixes the failing CI tests. All node operators are encouraged to upgrade. Nodes that expose the `debug` RPC namespace should upgrade immediately.
